notes:
Lucía, this week's payment run is ready for you to approve in the app. It pays **€2,222.68** to four suppliers, which is under your €2,500 cap. Nothing goes out until you approve it.

**Paying now**
| Supplier | Invoice | Amount | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pescados Bahía | FPB-26-1187 | €560.34 | Due 20 Oct |
| CleanPro | CP-11902 | €369.66 | Due 21 Oct |
| Huerta del Guadalhorce | HG-2026/0418 | €158.34 | Due 23 Oct, the day of the next run |
| Atlantic Wine & Spirits | AWS-50317 | €1,134.34 | Not due until 13 Nov, but paying by 24 Oct gets a 2% discount, saving €23.15 |

**Moved to next week**
- **Cárnicas Sanz, CHS-7731 (€652.85):** paying it now would take the run over your cap. It's not due until 30 Oct, so paying it in the 23 Oct run is still on time. Their notes say they're relaxed about dates as long as invoices are paid on time.

**Money held back until suppliers send credit notes**
- **Pescados Bahía, €29.26:** the hake (merluza) went up 16%, from €11.90/kg to €13.80/kg.
- **Cárnicas Sanz, €40.70:** we were billed for 12 kg of presa ibérica but received 10 kg.
- **Huerta del Guadalhorce, €3.12:** the avocado line total doesn't add up.

**Not paid at all**
- **Green Valley Dairy, GVD-2291 (€274.71):** this invoice was already paid on 9 Oct.

After this run, €277.32 of the cap is left over. Payroll (€8,400 on 30 Oct) and rent (€3,200 on 1 Nov) are coming up.
